limitations: Only 15 clear English single-source questions, five per datasource; no broad accuracy or statistical superiority claim.
Labels were frozen before predictions, independently of A/C outputs, using actual project sources. One analyst; no independent second human annotation.
Previous two-question results were known; this is a bounded diagnostic, not a pristine held-out benchmark.
SQL DB and Chroma index are absent; downstream availability and answers were not evaluated or initialized.
Native chains module import lacks langchain_ollama; exact source-loaded loader, schema and validator were reused with actual SDK inference; no provider mocks or graph run.
Returned raw SDK probabilities have four decimal places and are not validated for calibration; margins are top-1 minus runner-up, not the SDK entropy confidence.
Model load emitted unchanged clamp warning for unused choice:11+ temperature bucket; effective Choice3-5 temperature remained 1.7601518630981445.

Preflight first attempt passed encoding then failed in diagnostic console formatting (flush argument), before any inference. Only that harness logging error was corrected; failed validation artifacts are preserved. Criteria, labels and model parameters were not changed.

source_descriptions.vectorstore: Documentation about Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic RAG patterns with LangGraph, and LLM evaluation with RAGAS.
source_descriptions.sql: A SQLite database of a fictional online store with three tables: products (name, category, price), sales (product, quantity, date, country) and product_reviews (product, rating, country, review_date, comment).
source_descriptions.web_search: current events, recent facts, or anything not covered by the other two sources.
